PASELEC EM04 – High-Performance Electric Dirt Bike

Built for Adventure. Powered for the Trails.

Experience the excitement of off-road riding with the PASELEC EM04 Electric Dirt Bike. Equipped with a powerful 2600W peak brushless motor, a removable 48V 20.8Ah lithium-ion battery, and advanced hydraulic suspension, the EM04 is designed for riders seeking performance, control, and adventure.

With a top speed of up to 40 MPH and a maximum range of up to 53 miles, this high-performance electric off-road motorcycle delivers a powerful riding experience across a variety of trail conditions.

Key Features

2600W Peak Brushless Motor – Powerful Off-Road Performance

Take on challenging terrain with a high-performance brushless motor delivering up to 2600W of peak power and 140 N·m of torque.

3 Selectable Speed Modes

Whether you're exploring dirt trails or navigating uneven terrain, the EM04 provides responsive electric power for your off-road adventures.

48V 20.8Ah Removable Battery – Up to 53 Miles

Enjoy extended off-road adventures with the EM04's high-capacity lithium-ion battery.

Removable Battery Design

Battery Management System (BMS)

Charge the battery while installed in the motorcycle or remove it for convenient charging.

Actual range varies depending on rider weight, terrain, speed, riding mode, temperature, and other conditions.

Dual Hydraulic Suspension – Built for Rough Terrain

The EM04 features front and rear hydraulic suspension designed to absorb bumps and improve riding comfort.

Full Suspension Design

Enjoy improved control and comfort when riding on dirt paths, gravel trails, and uneven surfaces.

Front & Rear Hydraulic Disc Brakes

Ride with greater confidence thanks to the EM04's hydraulic braking system.

Front Hydraulic Disc Brake

Rear Hydraulic Disc Brake

Responsive Braking Performance

The braking system is designed to provide controlled stopping performance in a variety of off-road riding conditions.

3 Riding Modes – Choose Your Speed

Adjust your riding experience to match your skill level and terrain.

Choose a lower-speed mode for more controlled riding or switch to Sport Mode when conditions and rider experience allow.

14-Inch Front & 12-Inch Rear Off-Road Tires

Designed for off-road exploration, the EM04 features knobby tires that provide traction on a variety of loose and uneven surfaces.

Suitable for Dirt, Gravel, and Off-Road Trails

Multifunctional LCD Display

Stay informed while riding with an easy-to-read LCD dashboard displaying important riding information.

Current Speed

Riding Mode

Mileage

Lighting Status

Adjustable Headlight & Key Ignition

The EM04 includes a 90° adjustable headlight to improve visibility in low-light conditions.

A key-operated ignition system provides convenient access control, while the removable battery offers added charging flexibility.

Technical Specifications

Who Is the PASELEC EM04 For?

The PASELEC EM04 is designed for adult riders seeking a powerful electric dirt bike for recreational off-road adventures.

Experienced off-road riding enthusiasts

Riders looking for a high-performance electric dirt bike

Recreational trail and dirt-track riding

Adults seeking an electric alternative to traditional gas-powered dirt bikes

Although the EM04 offers selectable speed modes, its high maximum speed and powerful motor make it better suited to riders with previous motorcycle or off-road riding experience.

Important Riding & Safety Information

For off-road use. This electric dirt bike is intended for recreational riding in areas where motorized off-road vehicles are permitted. It is not represented as street-legal or approved for public-road use.

Always wear a properly fitted helmet and appropriate protective riding gear. Follow local regulations and ride within your experience level.

Maximum speed and range are manufacturer-advertised figures and may vary under actual riding conditions.
